_comment: Pilot profile overlay — inject connection strings and scale-honest defaults. Loaded after base appsettings and before appsettings.Advanced.json (see ArchLucid.Api/Program.cs). Does not set AgentExecution:Mode=Real or partial AzureOpenAI (those belong in appsettings.Real.sample.json / env / user secrets — docs/library/FIRST_REAL_VALUE.md). Partial AzureOpenAI without an API key fails local and Simulator startup.
